page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd-metal is a bare-metal server configuration engineered for high-throughput computing, memory-intensive services, and low-latency storage workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor, this instance delivers 144 physical cores and 288 threads via dedicated CPU allocation at up to 4.2 GHz. The CPU subsystem features a 504 MB Level 3 cache alongside extensive hardware-level instruction extensions, including AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware cryptography accelerators. The system is equipped with 2232 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, offering roughly 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU, without bundled GPU accelerators.

Integrated directly into the host are six NVMe SSD drives totaling 19326 GB of high-speed local storage. Benchmark results show exceptional multi-core performance, achieving a top-tier stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 313,266.86 and a PassMark CPU score of 178,741.62. Memory throughput is notably high, recording 1090.21 GB/sec on large-block read operations and 412.25 GB/sec on writes. In application benchmarks, the server processed 422.06 million Redis SET operations per second and maintained 167.86 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

While the instance excels in aggregate throughput and multi-threaded decompression (1817.29 GB/sec), workloads relying strictly on single-core execution or lightweight model text generation present tradeoffs. For instance, text generation on a 135M parameter LLM benchmarked at 41.9 tokens/sec, placing it in the bottom 10%, whereas medium 7B model prompt processing ranked in the top tier at 299.84 tokens/sec. The lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses requires network architectural planning for external egress.

Given its massive scale, dense DDR5 footprint, and substantial local NVMe storage, this server offers strong resource consolidation efficiency for massive databases, in-memory caches, distributed compile jobs, and large-scale data processing pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd-metal is a high-capacity bare-metal server featuring an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 144 physical cores and 288 dedicated vCPUs clocked at up to 4.2 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with 504 MB of L3 cache, it integrates 2232 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory (6 GHz) and 19326 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across six drives, without integrated GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show top-tier multi-threaded compute and memory performance, evidenced by 313,266.86 on multi-core stress-ng tests, 422.06 million Redis SET operations per second, and 167.86 GB/sec in static web throughput. Single-threaded LLM generation speeds represent a performance tradeoff compared to its massive parallel data processing capabilities. The server is engineered for demanding memory-centric workloads, enterprise databases, in-memory data grids, and large software builds requiring dense CPU and storage performance.
